Votes for Hakeem Jeffries for Speaker.
Rep. Tony Cárdenas announces his retirement and endorses her.
She is a member of the Congressional Progressive Caucus.
Her only serious challenger in 2026 came from within her party: Democrat Angélica María Dueñas, who took 42.7% in the general election.

Dueñas's campaign site lists eight groups under its 2026 endorsements: Northridge Indivisible, Feel the Bern LA, Feel the Bern SFV, Organize for Peace, Track AIPAC / Citizens against AIPAC, Courage for Democracy / Citizens Impeachment, Progressive Voter Network and CAIR Action (read Nov 24, 2026).
On the 76 votes where Democrats split, she agreed with Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez 85.1% of the time, Jeffries 84.5%, and centrist Josh Gottheimer 28.1%.
